title: Differential input/output token pricing + streaming surcharge experiment
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Validate a pricing model that charges different per-token rates for input vs output tokens and introduces an explicit streaming surcharge (per-minute or per-streamed-token minimum), with special contract language for enterprise deals. Rationale: many customers are heavy-output (generation) or heavy-input (embedding + retrieval) and current uniform per-token pricing can under/overcharge relative to compute and network cost. Streaming has different cost characteristics (long-lived connections, smaller per-token overhead but higher real-time resource utilization) and warrants a separate signal in price. We will run an A/B test across new signups and a subset of existing customers, instrument billing and revenue metrics, and capture contract/legal feedback for enterprise SAs. This ticket coordinates the experiment design, telemetry, legal questionnaire updates, and downstream billing implementation.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Instrumentation records token_count_input, token_count_output, streaming_session_flag, streaming_duration_seconds, and billing_charge per request in analytics.
2) Dashboard shows net revenue per 1k tokens for each variant with 95% CI after 4 weeks.
3) No customer-impacting billing regressions in canary (0 refunds, <1% unexpected invoice adjustments).
4) Legal sign-off on updated security & pricing section in standard SOW and security questionnaire language.
5) Rollout plan documented and engineering PRs merged for billing engine and pricing table UI.
measurement_plan: Primary metric: Change in net revenue per 1,000 tokens (normalized for usage mix). Secondary metrics: new signups conversion rate, churn signal in first 30 days, average invoice amount, number of billing disputes. Safety metrics: 5xx error rate on billing API, streaming connection failure rate. Minimum experiment window: 28 days or 100k billed customers-exposed tokens, whichever occurs first.
variants: control: uniform rate (baseline) - single token_rate 0.0006 USD per token
variant_A: differential IO - input_rate=0.0004 USD, output_rate=0.0008 USD
variant_B: differential + streaming surcharge - input_rate=0.00035 USD, output_rate=0.0007 USD, streaming_surcharge=0.02 USD per active stream minute (min 0.20 per stream)
variant_C: output discount with streaming flat fee - input_rate=0.00045 USD, output_rate=0.00065 USD, streaming_flat_per_stream=0.15 USD
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (Canary): internal customers + 2% of new signups for 1 week. Phase 2: 10% of signups + opt-in existing customers for 4 weeks. Phase 3: full rollout for new signups with gradual migration path for existing customers and enterprise negotiation window. Billing team to enable safe rollback and unit tests. Legal to push updated pricing clause to Salesforce CPQ templates for enterprise deals during Phase 2.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Perceived double-charging for streaming + output tokens -> Mitigation: user-facing example pricing calculator and invoice line-item clarity; trial credits for affected customers.
Risk: Enterprise contracts require fixed per-token caps -> Mitigation: pre-vetted contract language and list of acceptable exceptions; allow negotiation with dedicated AE and product discounts.
Risk: Instrumentation lag creates mis-billing -> Mitigation: sanity checks, simulated replay tests, and a throttled canary with 24/7 on-call coverage.
Risk: Increased support volume -> Mitigation: prepare KB article and templated responses; +1 CS headcount during experiment.
legal_and_security_notes: Update security questionnaire: add explicit note on how token counts are collected and stored (transient logs only), confirm streaming session metadata retention policy, and outline encryption-at-rest for billing metadata. Legal requests clause templates for enterprise SOW specifying billing determinism and credits. Security to confirm there is no additional user data persisted beyond token counts and streaming metadata.
